title: Algérie Poste workers’ work stoppage
reason: The opened report documents work stoppages at post offices but no qualifying public assembly or public crowd. A workplace stoppage is not itself a public gathering.
notes: The opened report covers work stoppages on 28–29 January and a court ruling for 28–29 January at some post offices; that legal period does not establish the physical end of any stoppage. Search-only S002–S010 concern the same or related stoppage and do not establish an assembly.

title: Annaba UGTA sections’ internal general assembly on labor-law drafts
reason: The body describes an internal union general assembly at the union college, not a public protest. Its “more than 500” figure counts union sections, not people attending; no individual crowd size is given.
notes: The 21 January article says the assembly occurred on Thursday; the exact day is not recorded here. The date is retained at month precision. The separate CSA demand is not coded as an occurrence at this assembly.
